## Introduction
We want to find out if the energy profiles of different countries is related to GDP.

## Data Cleaning

```{r}
#load dataframe
wfb_df <- read.csv('cleaned_wfb.csv')


### Coal

#function to clean columns related to coal
clean_coal_column <- function(x) {
  # Remove text like 'metric tons' and any parentheses content
  x <- gsub(" metric tons.*", "", x)  # Remove 'metric tons' and anything after it
  x <- gsub("\\(.*\\)", "", x)         # Remove anything in parentheses like '(2022 est.)'
  
  # Convert 'million' to 1e6 and 'billion' to 1e9
  x <- gsub(" million", "e6", x)      # Convert 'million' to 'e6'
  x <- gsub(" billion", "e9", x)      # Convert 'billion' to 'e9'
  x <- gsub(" trillion", "e12", x)      # Convert 'trillion' to 'e12'
  
  # Remove any commas and extra spaces
  x <- gsub(",", "", x)  # Remove commas
  
  # Convert to numeric after handling the units
  return(as.numeric(x))  # Convert the cleaned string to numeric
}

#Clean column for coal production
wfb_df$Energy..Coal...production = sapply(wfb_df$Energy..Coal...production, clean_coal_column)


#coal in metric tonnes; convert to BTU
#using 11,500 BTU/lb according to NC State
wfb_df$Energy..Coal...production = wfb_df$Energy..Coal...production *2204.62*11500


#Clean and convert column for Energy..Coal...import
wfb_df$Energy..Coal...imports = sapply(wfb_df$Energy..Coal...imports, clean_coal_column)
wfb_df$Energy..Coal...imports = wfb_df$Energy..Coal...imports *2204.62*11500

#Clean and convert column for Energy..Coal...exports
wfb_df$Energy..Coal...exports = sapply(wfb_df$Energy..Coal...exports, clean_coal_column)
wfb_df$Energy..Coal...exports = wfb_df$Energy..Coal...exports *2204.62*11500



### Natural Gas

#function to clean columns related to natural gas
clean_natural_gas_column <- function(x) {
  # Remove text like 'cubic meters' and any parentheses content
  x <- gsub(" cubic meters.*", "", x)  # Remove 'metric tons' and anything after it
  x <- gsub("\\(.*\\)", "", x)         # Remove anything in parentheses like '(2022 est.)'
  
  # Convert 'million' to 1e6 and 'billion' to 1e9
  x <- gsub(" million", "e6", x)      # Convert 'million' to 'e6'
  x <- gsub(" billion", "e9", x)      # Convert 'billion' to 'e9'
  x <- gsub(" trillion", "e12", x)      # Convert 'trillion' to 'e12'
  
  # Remove any commas and extra spaces
  x <- gsub(",", "", x)  # Remove commas
  
  # Convert to numeric after handling the units
  return(as.numeric(x))  # Convert the cleaned string to numeric
}

#clean column for natural gas production
wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...production = sapply(wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...production, clean_natural_gas_column)


#natural gas in cubic meters; convert to BTU
#34,121 BTU/m^3 according to BP
#i never cleaned this column yet
wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...production = wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...production * 34121



#also clean Natural.gas..imports
wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...imports = sapply(wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...imports, clean_natural_gas_column)
wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...imports = wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...imports * 34121

# Clean column for Energy..Natural.gas...exports
wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...exports = sapply(wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...exports, clean_natural_gas_column)
wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...exports = wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...exports * 34121



### Petroleum

#function to clean columns related to petroleum
clean_petroleum_column <- function(x) {
  # Remove text like 'metric tons' and any parentheses content
  x <- gsub(" bbl/day.*", "", x)  # Remove 'metric tons' and anything after it
  x <- gsub("\\(.*\\)", "", x)         # Remove anything in parentheses like '(2022 est.)'
  
  # Convert 'million' to 1e6 and 'billion' to 1e9
  x <- gsub(" million", "e6", x)      # Convert 'million' to 'e6'
  x <- gsub(" billion", "e9", x)      # Convert 'billion' to 'e9'
  x <- gsub(" trillion", "e12", x)      # Convert 'trillion' to 'e12'
  
  # Remove any commas and extra spaces
  x <- gsub(",", "", x)  # Remove commas
  
  # Convert to numeric after handling the units
  return(as.numeric(x))  # Convert the cleaned string to numeric
}

#clean columns for petroleum production
wfb_df$Energy..Petroleum...total.petroleum.production = sapply(wfb_df$Energy..Petroleum...total.petroleum.production, clean_petroleum_column)

#petroleum in barrels per day; convert to BTU
#5.8e6 BTU per barrel of oil according to BP
wfb_df$Energy..Petroleum...total.petroleum.production = wfb_df$Energy..Petroleum...total.petroleum.production * 365 * 5.8e6



#make aggregate of total dirty production
wfb_df <- wfb_df %>%
  mutate(total_production = rowSums(select(., Energy..Coal...production, Energy..Natural.gas...production, Energy..Petroleum...total.petroleum.production), na.rm = TRUE))


### GDP per capita

#function to clean gdp columns
clean_gdp_column <- function(x) {
  # Remove dollar sign and commas
  x <- gsub("^\\$", "", x)  # Remove the first dollar sign
  x <- gsub(",", "", x)     # Remove the commas
  
  # Remove everything after the first numeric value (remove text like 'est.', etc.)
  x <- gsub(" .*", "", x)   # Remove everything after the first number
  
  # Convert to numeric and return
  return(as.numeric(x))  # Convert cleaned string to numeric
}

wfb_df$Economy..Real.GDP.per.capita = sapply(wfb_df$Economy..Real.GDP.per.capita, clean_gdp_column)



# Consumption

clean_consumption_column <- function(x) {
  # Remove text like 'metric tons' and any parentheses content
  x <- gsub(" Btu/person.*", "", x)  # Remove 'metric tons' and anything after it
  x <- gsub("\\(.*\\)", "", x)         # Remove anything in parentheses like '(2022 est.)'
  
  # Convert 'million' to 1e6 and 'billion' to 1e9
  x <- gsub(" million", "e6", x)      # Convert 'million' to 'e6'
  x <- gsub(" billion", "e9", x)      # Convert 'billion' to 'e9'
  x <- gsub(" trillion", "e12", x)      # Convert 'trillion' to 'e12'
  
  # Remove any commas and extra spaces
  x <- gsub(",", "", x)  # Remove commas
  
  # Convert to numeric after handling the units
  return(as.numeric(x))  # Convert the cleaned string to numeric
}

wfb_df$Energy..Energy.consumption.per.capita = sapply(wfb_df$Energy..Energy.consumption.per.capita, clean_consumption_column)


### Population
clean_population_column <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub(",", "", x)     # Remove the commas

  # Convert to numeric and return
  return(as.numeric(x))  # Convert cleaned string to numeric
}

wfb_df$People.and.Society..Population...total = sapply(wfb_df$People.and.Society..Population...total, clean_population_column)



### Production/Imports/Exports per capita

wfb_df$Energy..Energy.production.per.capita =
(wfb_df$total_production)/(wfb_df$People.and.Society..Population...total)


wfb_df$Dirty_imports_percapita =
(wfb_df$Energy..Coal...imports + wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...imports)/(wfb_df$People.and.Society..Population...total)

wfb_df$Dirty_exports_percapita =
(wfb_df$Energy..Coal...exports + wfb_df$Energy..Natural.gas...exports)/(wfb_df$People.and.Society..Population...total)



### Continents

wfb_df$Geography..Map.references[wfb_df$Geography..Map.references == "Arctic Region"] <- "Europe"
wfb_df$Geography..Map.references[wfb_df$Geography..Map.references == "AsiaEurope"] <- "Europe"
wfb_df$Geography..Map.references[wfb_df$Geography..Map.references == "Southeast Asia"] <- "Asia"
wfb_df$Geography..Map.references[wfb_df$Geography..Map.references == "Central America and the Caribbean"] <- "South America"
wfb_df$Geography..Map.references[wfb_df$Country == "France"] <- "Europe"

wfb_df$Geography..Map.references[wfb_df$Country == "World"] <- "World"



### Electricity/Clean Energy
# Electricity generating capacity is KW
# Clean energy sources are given as a percentage of the total electricity generating capacity
# Electricity imports and exports are in kwh

# Clean electricity capacity columns; Unit is KW; Signifies amount of energy that can be instantaneously produced at max capacity
wfb_df <- wfb_df %>%
  mutate(Energy..Electricity...installed.generating.capacity = case_when(
    grepl("billion", Energy..Electricity...installed.generating.capacity, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
      as.numeric(sub(" .*", "", Energy..Electricity...installed.generating.capacity)) * 1e9,
    grepl("million", Energy..Electricity...installed.generating.capacity, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
      as.numeric(sub(" .*", "", Energy..Electricity...installed.generating.capacity)) * 1e6,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", "", sub(" .*", "", Energy..Electricity...installed.generating.capacity)))
  ))

# Clean solar column
wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...solar <- as.numeric(
  sub("%.*", "", wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...solar)
) / 100


# Clean hydroelectricity column
wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...hydroelectricity <- as.numeric(
  sub("%.*", "", wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...hydroelectricity)
) / 100

# Clean biomass column
wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...biomass.and.waste <- as.numeric(
  sub("%.*", "", wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...biomass.and.waste)
) / 100

# Clean nuclear column
wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...nuclear <- as.numeric(
  sub("%.*", "", wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...nuclear)
) / 100

# Clean wind column
wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...nuclear <- as.numeric(
  sub("%.*", "", wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...nuclear)
) / 100

# Clean wind column
wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...wind <- as.numeric(
  sub("%.*", "", wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...wind)
) / 100

#Clean geothermal column
wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...geothermal <- as.numeric(
  sub("%.*", "", wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...geothermal)
) / 100

# Clean tide and wave column
wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...tide.and.wave <- as.numeric(
  sub("%.*", "", wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...tide.and.wave)
) / 100



#convert percentages of clean energy to capacity in KW
wfb_df$Energy_solar = wfb_df$Energy..Electricity...installed.generating.capacity * 
                      (wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...solar)

wfb_df$Energy_hydro = wfb_df$Energy..Electricity...installed.generating.capacity * 
                      (wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...hydroelectricity)

wfb_df$Energy_biomass = wfb_df$Energy..Electricity...installed.generating.capacity * 
                      (wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...biomass.and.waste)

wfb_df$Energy_nuclear = wfb_df$Energy..Electricity...installed.generating.capacity * 
                      (wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...nuclear)

wfb_df$Energy_wind = wfb_df$Energy..Electricity...installed.generating.capacity * 
                      (wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...wind)

wfb_df$Energy_geothermal = wfb_df$Energy..Electricity...installed.generating.capacity * 
                      (wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...geothermal)

wfb_df$Energy_tide = wfb_df$Energy..Electricity...installed.generating.capacity * 
                      (wfb_df$Energy..Electricity.generation.sources...tide.and.wave)


#make column for total clean energy capacity in KW
wfb_df$Total_clean_energy <- rowSums(wfb_df[, c(
  "Energy_solar",
  "Energy_hydro",
  "Energy_biomass",
  "Energy_nuclear",
  "Energy_wind",
  "Energy_geothermal",
  "Energy_tide"
)], na.rm = TRUE)


#clean column Energy..Electricity...consumption; get rid of million, billions, ...
#convert kwh to BTU; 1 kwh = 3412.142 BTU
wfb_df <- wfb_df %>%
  mutate(Energy..Electricity...consumption = case_when(
    grepl("trillion", Energy..Electricity...consumption, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
      as.numeric(sub(" .*", "", Energy..Electricity...consumption)) * 1e12,
    grepl("billion", Energy..Electricity...consumption, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
      as.numeric(sub(" .*", "", Energy..Electricity...consumption)) * 1e9,
    grepl("million", Energy..Electricity...consumption, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
      as.numeric(sub(" .*", "", Energy..Electricity...consumption)) * 1e6,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", "", sub(" .*", "", Energy..Electricity...consumption)))
  ))

#convert Electricity consumption to BTU
wfb_df$Energy..Electricity...consumption = wfb_df$Energy..Electricity...consumption * 3412.142

# make consumption and production per capita; not consumption is in BTU, production is generating capacity in KW
wfb_df$Electricity_consumption_percapita = (wfb_df$Energy..Electricity...consumption)/(wfb_df$People.and.Society..Population...total)

wfb_df$Clean_energy_production_percapita = 
(wfb_df$Total_clean_energy)/(wfb_df$People.and.Society..Population...total)


# Clean columns for Electricity imports and exports
#imports
wfb_df <- wfb_df %>%
  mutate(Energy..Electricity...imports = case_when(
    grepl("billion", Energy..Electricity...imports, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
      as.numeric(sub(" .*", "", Energy..Electricity...imports)) * 1e9,
    grepl("million", Energy..Electricity...imports, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
      as.numeric(sub(" .*", "", Energy..Electricity...imports)) * 1e6,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", "", sub(" .*", "", Energy..Electricity...imports)))
  ))

#exports
wfb_df <- wfb_df %>%
  mutate(Energy..Electricity...exports = case_when(
    grepl("billion", Energy..Electricity...exports, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
      as.numeric(sub(" .*", "", Energy..Electricity...exports)) * 1e9,
    grepl("million", Energy..Electricity...exports, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
      as.numeric(sub(" .*", "", Energy..Electricity...exports)) * 1e6,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", "", sub(" .*", "", Energy..Electricity...exports)))
  ))

# make imports per capita
wfb_df$Electricity_imports_percapita = 
(wfb_df$Energy..Electricity...imports)/(wfb_df$People.and.Society..Population...total)
#make exports per capits
wfb_df$Electricity_exports_percapita = 
(wfb_df$Energy..Electricity...exports)/(wfb_df$People.and.Society..Population...total)

#convert kwh to BTU
wfb_df$Electricity_imports_percapita_btu = wfb_df$Electricity_imports_percapita * 3412.142

wfb_df$Electricity_exports_percapita_btu = wfb_df$Electricity_exports_percapita * 3412.142

#make aggregates
wfb_df$Total_energy_imports_percapita = wfb_df$Dirty_imports_percapita + wfb_df$Electricity_imports_percapita_btu

wfb_df$Total_energy_exports_percapita = wfb_df$Dirty_exports_percapita + wfb_df$Electricity_exports_percapita_btu

```
